rationale: Joseph brings hands-on robotics and agri-robotics experience from Nupeak Robotics, while Sharon is building production-ready AI agent infrastructure at TheAgentic.Ai — a pairing that could unlock autonomous systems for agriculture or other physical domains. intro_message: Joseph Zheng, meet Sharon — you're both working at the intersection of autonomous systems and AI, and your robotics background + her AI agent infrastructure expertise could spark ideas for how agents power physical automation.
